name: Pullback to a demand / supply area
idea: In the direction the Daily structure allows, wait for the price to pull back into a demand area (or a supply area) and for a commitment candle to close back out of it. The idea is wrong beyond the area's far edge. The ported level method, every number a setting.

params.label: Room to the next area
params.help: The distance from the commitment close to the next opposite area must be at least this many times the distance to the invalidation; with less room there is no signal.

params.label: Bars to wait after the visit
params.help: After the price reaches the area, a commitment candle must come within this many closed bars; later, the visit is over.

params.label: Candles for the typical range
params.help: The typical candle range is the median range of this many earlier closed candles; the other distances are counted in it.

params.label: Approach candles checked
params.help: How many candles up to the visit are checked for a forceful drive into the area.

params.label: Wide approach candle
params.help: An approach candle is wide when its range is at least this many typical ranges.

params.label: Approach close near its end
params.help: A wide approach candle counts as forceful when it closes within this fraction of its range at the end it is moving to.

params.label: Forceful candles in a row
params.help: This many forceful candles in a row into the area mean an impulsive approach: no signal on that visit.

params.label: Buffer beyond the far edge
params.help: The idea is wrong beyond the area's far edge (and the extreme since the visit) by this many typical ranges.

params.label: Wait for the next candle
params.help: On: the candle after the commitment must also close beyond the area before the signal.

params.label: Signals during a larger correction
params.help: On: signals also while the Daily structure is in a larger correction. Off: none then.

params.label: Signs of a power shift
params.help: How many signs of the pullback losing force the study needs.

params.label: Pullback losing force read
params.help: How shrinking pullback candles are read.

params.label: Commitment body size
params.help: The commitment candle's body must be at least this many times the average body since the visit.

params.label: Candles for the area study
params.help: The handover study inside the area needs at least this many candles.

params.label: Equal lows / highs tolerance
params.help: Two lows (or highs) inside the area count as equal within this many typical ranges.

params.label: Overlap of pullback candles
params.help: Pullback candles count as overlapping when this fraction of their bodies overlaps.

params.label: Body share of a strong candle
params.help: A strong candle's body is at least this fraction of its range.

params.label: Commitment close beyond
params.help: The commitment candle closes beyond the previous candle's close, or beyond its extreme.

params.label: Rejection wick share
params.help: A rejection (pin) candle's wick at the area is at least this fraction of its range.

params.label: Star middle candle body
params.help: The middle candle of a star is at most this fraction of its range.

params.label: Tweezer tolerance
params.help: Two candle extremes count as a tweezer within this fraction of their average range.

params.label: Close near the candle's end
params.help: A commitment candle closes within the outer part of its range: at least this fraction from the other end.

params.label: Candles for the candle average
params.help: How many earlier candles make the average a candle is compared with.

params.label: Doji body
params.help: A candle whose body is at most this fraction of its range is a doji: the study waits for the next candle.

params.label: Candles for the pullback read
params.help: Without a known pullback start, the pullback is read over this many candles.

params.label: Candles for the break range
params.help: The typical range used to judge a real break of the far edge, over this many candles.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: A close beyond the far edge by at least this many typical ranges can be a real break.

params.label: A strong breaking candle confirms
params.help: On: one strong candle beyond the far edge confirms a real break at once.

params.label: Breaking candle close
params.help: A strong breaking candle closes within this fraction of its range at the break side.

params.label: Breaking candle size
params.help: A strong breaking candle's range is at least this many typical ranges.

params.label: Bars without a reclaim
params.help: Without a strong candle, a break is real when the price does not come back inside for this many candles.

params.label: Closes beyond to accept
params.help: This many closes in a row beyond the far edge also make a real break.
